description: This Dart source file defines a FavoritesProvider class that manages a set of favorite recipe IDs. It handles loading, toggling, and checking favorite statuses, persisting data using SharedPreferences, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: FavoritesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages favorite recipe IDs with persistent storage and provides methods to load, toggle, and check favorites.

methods.name: loadFavorites
methods.description: Loads favorite recipe IDs from SharedPreferences into memory. Ensures this is only done once.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks whether a specific recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe ID and updates persistent storage. Notifies listeners immediately.
